rows.quote: Sepsis genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics were downloaded from the IEU OpenGWAS platform (https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/), including a sepsis study containing 11,643 cases and 474,841 controls (GWAS ID: ieu-b-4980), and a 28-day sepsis study containing 1,896 cases and 484,588 controls (GWAS ID: ieu-b-5086).

rows.quote: Plasma protein quantitative trait loci (cis-pQTLs) were curated from two large-scale proteomics research cohorts: (1) The Decode cohort (https://www.decode.com/summarydata/), which includes data on 4,907 plasma proteins from 35,559 participants [15] and (2) the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) (https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn51364943/wiki/622119), which includes data on 2,923 plasma proteins from 54,219 participants [16].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E Sulem P Atlason BA Sveinbjornsson G Magnusson MI Styrmisdottir EL Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat Genet 2021 53 1712 21 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: Step 2. The sentence attributes the Decode cohort data to reference [15], whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is the source identifier of exactly one dictionary row; the sentence's 35,559 participants and 4,907 proteins equal that row's N and assay count, and nothing conflicts.

Step 4, rule C3. The passages give UKB-PPP with the whole-deposit Synapse identifier syn51364943, the Sun et al. 2023 citation [16] (source of four dictionary rows) and 54,219 participants, which equals no row's N; no attribute separates the rows.
